rationale:
Positives: The agent properly authenticated the user using full name + zip, located the grill order, and did not perform any cancellation without explicit confirmation. When the user changed their mind, the agent did not execute a write and correctly stated the grill order remained pending. For the t-shirt query, the agent checked an order and accurately described the one t-shirt in that order and asked for clarification to find a second one.

Issue leading to fail: The agent stated the t-shirt was in a “delivered order” without tool evidence supporting that delivery status in the shown order details. This constitutes stating an unsupported fact per policy. Everything else adhered to policy, but this unsupported claim triggers the fail condition of providing information not backed by tools.
